purpose: Resolve the relationship of a person or organisation to a specific property interest at a defined date without treating names, occupation or document appearance as proof of ownership.
core_principle: PERSON/ORGANISATION → ROLE → INTEREST → PROPERTY → DATE → EVIDENCE
rules: A name match alone does not establish identity.
An address match alone does not establish a person's relationship to the property.
Being named in a deed, grant, court document or correspondence does not by itself establish registered ownership.
Registered proprietor and beneficial owner are distinct roles.
Personal representative and beneficiary/successor are distinct roles.
Mortgagee or charge holder is not the registered proprietor merely because security is recorded.
Occupier or tenant is not automatically owner.
A person may hold multiple distinct roles at different dates.
Historical role resolution requires evidence appropriate to the target date.
Where multiple people have similar names, the system must preserve ambiguity rather than select silently.
hard_stops: Never infer ownership from a name alone.
Never infer registered proprietorship from occupation or possession.
Never infer beneficial ownership from registered title alone.
Never merge two people because their names are similar.
Never use a current role to establish a historical role without historical evidence.
Never expose unnecessary personal information merely to resolve a role.
